about: I work on making long-context LLM inference cheaper in memory without giving up accuracy. My MSc thesis at Universitaet Trier, supervised by Prof. Dr. Volker Schulz, treats the KV cache as a fourth-order tensor and asks how much of it can be removed before accuracy moves. The resulting preprint, JoLT, reports near-lossless 2x to 3x compression across five models and four model families, plus a fused decode kernel that cuts peak decode memory by 3.61x.

Two smaller studies test whether a model's stated reasoning and confidence track what it actually does. Before the MSc I spent four years as a backend engineer at SAP Labs India, so every result I publish comes with reproducible evaluation, measured latency and memory, and stated limitations.
